Anya (pm): short sync: need a concrete decision on archive SLAs, export shape, and legal-hold mechanics for enterprise launches. quick takes below.

Mark (eng-infra): infra preference = per-tenant bucket, but support shared prefix. exports = tar.gz with manifest.json (sha256s + signatures). jobs async + presigned URL. idempotency token required.

Sofia (security): manifest must include PoP proof, rotation history (previous_key_id optional), and tamper-evident signature. legal-hold flag required in manifest.

Li (eng-runtime): runtime must never block inference for KMS outages; use ephemeral wrapping keys (TTL 60s), add X-Key-Source header. record metric pct_ephemeral.

Rachel (cs): customers expect export included in enterprise; archival beyond contract = paid add-on. will gather two ref customers to confirm.

Mia (legal): require approval trace to lift legal-hold (actor, timestamp, case id). store justification in immutable log.

Anya (pm): decision draft: defaults = 90d standard, 365d enterprise, legal-hold indefinite until approved; implement per-tenant bucket by default, support prefix option; exports as signed tar.gz with manifest; PoP on BYOK; ephemeral fallback for <60s. owners: Mark infra, Sofia security, Li runtime, Rachel CS, Mia legal. sign-off Thurs 5pm PT.

DeployBot: CI: feature/archival-slas -> staging 2024-10-20T04:00Z :rocket:

Anya (pm): thanks — will post the consolidated launch criteria and assign tasks.
